final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) AS cnt FROM trader AS tr LEFT JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg LEFT JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tx.transreg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS sum_counts, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM stats WHERE cnt > avg_cnt
